issues.issue: Fiscal year end is assumed. The City of Tecumseh's own fiscal year ends September 30 (Tecumseh_FY2025), so the airport authority may also be on a 9/30 year. Check the source filing.

This one line is 57% of the year's receipts and sits in 'other'. The page doesn't explain it (most likely hangar rent or fuel sales, i.e. charges for services). The extractor marked it for review. A person needs to confirm the category.
No function category fits an airport, so 'other' with review is defensible. It is still a judgment call.
